confidence_notes: Medium overall. Restaurant and drink anchors come from aggregated third-party figures (Numbeo-derived guides, Expatistan, WhereAndWhen and similar guides) with mixed dates, adjusted for July peak season. The cappuccino, inexpensive meal and mid-range three-course meal for two are the best supported; beer is moderately supported. The cocktail estimate is weak: no dated 2026 euro price was found, so it is a judgement for a mid-range bar, cross-checked against the beer anchor (about 3.4 times the beer price). The wine glass estimate starts from pintxos-bar wine prices of about EUR 2.50 to 4 and is uplifted for a sit-down restaurant; no sit-down by-the-glass price was found, so it also relies partly on the beer relationship. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July peak-season Basque coastal city, not based on live booking pages or current listings. EUR amounts were converted to USD at an assumed 1.15 USD per EUR from general knowledge; no EUR/USD observation was verified. The fx block is the most recent RBA observation visible in my search results (20 March 2026). I could not confirm an RBA observation close to the 2026-11-19 generation date, so the FX value may be stale and should be re-checked before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Restaurant and drink anchors are based on San Sebastian's own aggregated price data where found. One aggregator describes the city's prices as similar to Barcelona and Madrid, used only as a sense check. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for a Basque coastal city in peak summer and are not derived from a comparable city.
